summary:
Observed 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31 on organization Project 3. Two constraints pull against each other when new Delivery issues are filed as sub-issues.

Constraint 1, the row cap. The installed coord-0.113.0 reader refuses more than 100 payload rows while 93 rows were enrolled, leaving 7 (FS-GG/.github#4941 issuecomment-6519516153). The 250-row ceiling is source (V2Enrollment rowCap) and is readable only by a reader named as lifted; the preflight reports RowCapExceeded above 250 and treats 101 to 250 as supported only for a known lifted reader. The lift is source-only until the coherent CLI release is installed.

Constraint 2, auto-add. The Project 3 workflow Auto-add sub-issues to project adds every new sub-issue as an unadmitted, unenrolled card with no Status, Track or Work level. On 2026-10-30 seven such cards took membership from 98 to 105; board-v2 migration-prepare then refused even a one-issue Status preparation and board-v2 inspect failed with 67 barrier reads; Root removed the seven cards (FS-GG/.github#4941 issuecomment-6520038552). The earlier cohort-drift record github/board-cohort-membership-drift is the same mechanism.

The conflict. Filing the roughly 95 Delivery issues the 2026-10-31 backfill needed as sub-issues, with auto-add on, would have added about that many unadmitted cards to a board whose reader refuses more than 100 rows. The proposal named about 210 rows needed (FS-GG/.github#4730 issuecomment-6540174984).

Resolution recorded by Root (issuecomment-6540490595, docs/coordination/2026-10-31-delivery-backfill.md): the owner disabled the auto-add workflow first (A), the backfill created and linked native issues only, and enrollment is deferred to one batch through the #4941 planner after the CLI release carrying the 250 cap is installed (C). Readback in that record: the workflow read enabled false before the first effect and after the last, Project 3 held 98 items before and after, and no new issue had a Project 3 card; 98 native Delivery issues were created and 11 existing issues linked.

Lessons:
1. Keep sub-issue auto-add off while the reader cap is below the enrolled-plus-pending population, and read the workflow state before and after any bulk linking.
2. A native sub-issue link gives true done and open progress on the Outcome card without any board membership; enrollment is a separate protected, batched step.
3. Before filing many issues, compare enrolled rows plus pending rows with the installed reader cap, as the #4941 preflight does.

Limits: the counts are dated live facts from the cited comments and record; this grants no enrollment, workflow change or Status write, and the installed reader cap must be re-read before relying on it.
title: Project 3 sub-issue auto-add conflicts with the reader row cap, so Delivery issues are linked first and enrolled in a batch later
